# Cully 0.14.0

Cully now includes native Android and iOS Self-mode clients in [`apps/`](https://github.com/mcp-runtime/cully/tree/v0.14.0/apps), alongside the existing coding-agent CLI and MCP services.

- Today brings together a personal focus, local tasks and a dated brief from saved Cully work. Tasks and Advisor help capture next steps and handoffs.
- Ask Cully and its microphone are available from the main screens; there is no separate Talk navigation tab. Both apps reuse the Cully icon.
- Setup explicitly downloads checksum-pinned local language weights. Android also downloads Whisper speech weights; iOS uses on-device Apple speech when available. Inference has no paid cloud API dependency.
- The local language model follows the canonical Cully skill's mobile profile and chooses bounded read-only `cully_context` calls through [mcp-mobile 0.1.0](https://github.com/mcp-runtime/mcp-mobile/releases/tag/v0.1.0). Task changes remain explicit local UI actions. Workspace tools and coding terminals are not exposed.
- Native mobile CI checks skill/model manifests, Android compilation/dexing and iOS simulator compilation. Existing Go CLI/MCP packages continue to ship below.

## Mobile developer preview

The Android APK, when attached, is a development-signed arm64 preview targeting API 30, not a Play Store production build. It retains the existing `dev.local.aiphone` package identity so updates preserve app data. Install only as a test build; tap Setup to obtain weights. Keep its development signing key outside source control.

The iOS app is source-only in this release. Open `apps/ios/Cully.xcodeproj` and select your development team for an iPhone installation. No signed IPA, TestFlight or App Store build is published.

Verified: Go vet/race tests; both native SDKs connected to authenticated Cully for bounded read-only searches; Android Qwen loaded the shared skill and completed a model-selected MCP call and answer (43.5 seconds including UI polling); Apple CPU inference generated a synthetic test response on Mac. See [mobile verification](https://github.com/mcp-runtime/cully/blob/v0.14.0/apps/VERIFICATION.md) for physical iPhone, interactive mobile sign-in, full model-download and voice-quality checks still pending.

Models, tokens, signing keys and personal test output are not included in source archives. Maven Central publishing for the separate SDK remains pending account/namespace/signing setup; Swift consumers can use its released Git tag now.
